title: Senior Data Engineer (Seattle)

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Our Strategic Data team builds the data foundations that support business intelligence, machine learning, and operational decision-making. You'll help create reliable, scalable data models and pipelines while improving how teams use data across the business.

- Design and implement robust, scalable data models that support business intelligence, machine learning, and operational needs.

- Select appropriate schema designs-including star schema, snowflake, normalized, and denormalized models-based on the use case.

- Work with Data Platform Engineers and Product Managers to identify root causes of data issues and deliver efficient, scalable solutions.

- Explore practical ways for data engineering and AI to work together across our products and operations.

This role is based in Seattle, and you'll be expected to work from the office three days a week.

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, or a related field.

- Five or more years of experience designing and implementing ETL pipelines using tools such as Informatica, Talend, Apache NiFi, or similar data integration platforms.

- Strong experience with data modeling, data schemas, ETL, and end-to-end data workflows.

- Proficiency in SQL, database management systems such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle, and data warehousing solutions.

- Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery and Airflow.

- Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to producing high-quality work.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams.

- Strength in at least one core area of data engineering, particularly data modeling or ETL, with the ability to contribute across the broader data engineering discipline.

PREFERRED

- Experience in financial services, payments, or fintech.

- Knowledge of data governance practices and regulatory requirements in the financial industry.

- Experience with scripting languages such as Python or R for data analysis and automation.

title: Sr. Software Engineer

The Team + The Role

Pendo's engineering teams build the product experiences that help customers understand, improve, and act on product usage data. title: Local Community Recruiter – French Speaker (France)
description:
Join DataForce for a 4-5 weeks freelance project, using your local knowledge and community connections to recruit participants for an ongoing voice-recording data collection study.

• Language required : French (France) and English

• Work location : Remote, with local outreach in at least one of the target regions of France

• Target regions : North/Northeast or Southeast/Southwest France

• Engagement model : Freelance/Independent Contractor

• Preferred availability : 10-20 hours per week

• Estimated start : ASAP

• Estimated project duration : 4-5 weeks

• Compensation : €25 per hour, plus a €10 bonus for each eligible participant who completes the study successfully

We are seeking Local Community Recruiters to support recruitment for an ongoing voice data collection project in France.

We are looking for individuals with strong connections in one of the target regions (North/Northeast or Southeast/Southwest of France) who can identify and engage native French speakers with the required regional accents. Current recruitment priorities include adults aged 42 and above, and parents or legal guardians of children aged 7-17. Specific demographic targets will be provided during onboarding and may be updated throughout the project depending on project progression.

The study itself is completed remotely by participants using a smartphone. Recruiters will focus on local outreach, candidate generation and follow-up, helping eligible participants move from initial interest through registration and task completion.

The study is aimed to improve voice assistant technologies for French speaking users of various accents.

Role Summary

The Local Community Recruiter will develop and carry out targeted sourcing activities within an assigned region of France. The role requires a quality-focused approach, using trusted local networks, community organizations, associations, referrals, and other relevant channels to reach participants who may not be easily accessible through standard online advertising.

Recruiters will also maintain contact with candidates, explain the opportunity clearly and support them through the registration and participation process.

Role Responsibilities

• Identify and engage potential participants within the assigned target region

• Use local networks, community groups, associations, referrals and appropriate physical or digital outreach channels

• Focus recruitment on the regional, age and gender groups prioritized by the project

• Approach parents or legal guardians when recruiting children

• Clearly explain the study, eligibility requirements, registration process and compensation

• Support interested candidates through registration and task completion

• Follow up with eligible candidates and address basic questions or participation barriers

• Maintain accurate records of outreach activities, referrals and candidate progress

• Provide regular updates on results, challenges and local market feedback

• Coordinate closely with the DataForce Sourcing

• Follow all project guidelines, privacy requirements and ethical recruitment practices

Role Requirements

• Currently based in or strongly connected to North/Northeast or Southeast/Southwest France

• Idiomatic fluency in French (France)

• Sufficient English skills to understand project documentation and communicate with the internal team

• Established local networks and a strong understanding of the assigned region

• Ability to work independently

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Organized, proactive and comfortable following up with candidates

• Able to adapt quickly as recruitment priorities and demographic targets change

• Comfortable using online forms, spreadsheets and basic digital communication tools

• Access to a computer, reliable internet connection and telephone

title: Senior Developer Relations
description:
About our team:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale - powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our product team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

Job Summary:

As a Senior Developer Relations lead, you will help developers discover, understand, adopt, and get value from Radiant’s cloud platform.

You’ll work across developer education, technical content, community, product feedback, demos, reference implementations, and ecosystem engagement, partnering closely with product, engineering, solutions, marketing, and customers.

This is a technical, hands-on role focused on building trust with developers, improving adoption, and creating a strong feedback loop between the market and the product.

 

Key Responsibilities:

- Own Radiant’s developer relations strategy and execution across content, community, events, and product adoption.

- Create high-quality technical content, including tutorials, guides, reference architectures, demos, sample applications, and best practices.

- Build and maintain reference implementations, code samples, SDK examples, and developer resources.

- Engage directly with developers, customers, and technical communities to understand pain points and improve the product experience.

- Represent Radiant at technical events, meetups, conferences, workshops, and online communities.

- Partner with product and engineering to turn developer feedback into clear product insights and priorities.

- Help improve documentation, onboarding, developer experience, and time-to-first-workload.

- Support launches by creating the technical narrative, demos, and educational materials developers need to adopt new capabilities.

- Track engagement, adoption, developer sentiment, and the effectiveness of DevRel programs.

Qualifications:

- Experience in developer relations, developer advocacy, solutions engineering, product engineering, or a similar technical role.

- Strong technical background and comfortable building real examples using APIs, SDKs, cloud infrastructure, and modern developer tooling.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

- Comfortable with technologies such as LLM inference, training, python, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and developer platforms.

- Experience creating technical content, demos, workshops, or open-source examples.

- Comfortable engaging directly with developers and technical communities.

- Able to balance education, community building, product feedback, and adoption.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with a high degree of ownership.

What you bring:

- Technical credibility: You can build, test, and explain the product yourself.

- Developer empathy: You understand how developers evaluate, adopt, and struggle with platforms.

- Communication: You can make complex infrastructure understand

We're looking for an experienced automotive technology seller who understands how dealerships operate, knows how buying decisions are made across different dealer group structures, and can quickly establish credibility in the market. You'll need to be equally comfortable opening doors, developing executive relationships, running a complex consultative sales process, and finding creative paths into accounts.

Conversica is a lean, fast-moving organization, and this role is ideal for someone who thrives with autonomy. Beyond closing business, you'll bring insights from the market back into the organization and partner with Product, Customer Success, Marketing, and executive leadership to help shape our evolving Automotive go-to-market strategy.

• Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM activity.

• Partner closely with Customer Success to support successful customer transitions and identify opportunities for continued growth.

• Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and executive leadership, bringing forward customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights that help strengthen our product and go-to-market approach.

title: Senior Software Engineer, GPU
locationText: Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo's Compute Team is tasked with a critical and exciting mission: We deliver the compute platform responsible for running the fully autonomous vehicle’s software stack. To achieve our mission, we architect and create high-performance custom silicon; we develop system-level compute architectures that push the boundaries of performance, power, and latency; and we collaborate closely with many other teammates to ensure we design and optimize hardware and software for maximum performance. We are a multidisciplinary team seeking curious and talented teammates to work on one of the world’s highest performance automotive compute platforms.

In this hybrid role, you will report to an Engineering Manager.

You will:

• Develop high-performance GPU primitives and abstractions to enable Waymo to scale its accelerator codebase across diverse GPU backends

• Collaborate with Waymo's internal hardware team and external partners on SoC projects with a focus on the GPU portion

• Manage the bring-up, correctness, and performance of the Waymo onboard stack on new GPU platforms

• Contribute to testing infrastructure that enhances the CI/CD flow for GPUs, detects bugs early, and generates automated alerts to maintain the GPU stack's functionality and performance

• Create profiler and debugger tools for new GPU platforms

You have:

• Expertise in C++ programming for GPU (CUDA or similar framework)

• Bachelor degrees in EECS, coupled with a minimum of five years of industry experience

• Solid understanding of GPU software stack

• Solid understanding of key GPU hardware characteristics that are important to GPU SW efficiency

• Proficiency in utilizing performance analysis tools and debuggers

• Enthusiasm for developing the complete GPU software stack, from the hardware level to real-world applications

We prefer:

• Master/doctorate degree in EECS

• Prior excellence in landing solid, sophisticated, and efficient solutions at any level of the GPU stack

• Deep insights into GPU kernel performance, compilation flow, and driver stack

• Knowledgeable of Linux driver and embedded firmware

• Ability to quickly ramp on a diverse set of heterogeneous platforms and start solving problems

• Clear technical communicator, good leader and collaborator

• Familiarity with GPU libraries such as Thrust, CUB, CUTLASS, or Eigen

• Experience contributing to open-source compiler projects such as LLVM or SPIR-V

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

title: Engineer II, System validation Test - Insight QA
description:
LOCATION - BANGALORE

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Engineer II in System Validation Testing with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our cloud network management quality engineering team. The role focuses on hands-on testing of a cloud-hosted platform used to onboard, configure, monitor and manage networking devices such as access points, switches and routers.

The engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers and product teams to understand requirements, design and execute tests, automate repeatable workflows, investigate failures and contribute to reliable releases across the device, network, cloud, API and web or mobile application layers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

CLOUD NETWORK MANAGEMENT TESTING

· Understand feature requirements and expected customer workflows for cloud-managed access points, switches and routers.

· Test device onboarding, discovery, provisioning, configuration and removal workflows.

· Validate device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device operations and configuration synchronization.

· Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows.

· Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance.

· Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups.

TEST PLANNING AND EXECUTION

· Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team.

· Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions.

· Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments.

· Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests.

· Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early.

· Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows.

API CLOUD AND DATA VALIDATION

· Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries.

· Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling.

· Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces.

· Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers.

· Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures.

· Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments.

NETWORKING AND TROUBLESHOOTING

· Apply networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DHCP, DNS, ARP, ICMP, HTTP and HTTPS, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi.

· Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting.

· Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump.

· Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team.

TEST AUTOMATION

· Develop and maintain Python-based automation for APIs, device workflows and regression scenarios.

· Create or update UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent framework.

· Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components.

· Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope.

· Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence.

· Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation.

DEFECT MANAGEMENT AND TEAM COLLABORATION

· Log clear defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual behavior, logs, screenshots, API traces and packet captures when applicable.

· Participate in defect triage, daily stand-ups, sprint planning and test-status discussions.

· Collaborate with software, cloud, firmware, networking and mobile teams to reproduce and resolve issues.

title: Application Support Specialist
description:
About the opportunity
You’ll join the Client Service team in our Enterprise Fitness vertical as an Application Support Specialist, working remotely from Spain. The team provides 3rd level technical support for the Exerp Platform, our ERP for some of the largest fitness chain operators in the world, along with our web services and apps.
Our products are complex, highly customisable and built to flex around each client’s needs. You’ll work directly with our clients’ dedicated Exerp superusers and application specialists, who rely on us to solve their most critical problems quickly and well.
You will love this role if you enjoy getting to the bottom of complex technical problems and building strong working relationships with clients. The department is growing and changing, so there’s real room to develop your career with us.
Reporting into Manager of Client Services for Xplor , you’ll support our clients by:

• Acting as a daily point of contact for clients, mainly through tickets and also in client meetings

• Analysing and resolving complex product issues and questions, and bringing in the right internal people until the problem is solved

• Troubleshooting technical issues and tracking down bugs alongside a team of Technical Product Analysts

• Reporting issues directly to our Engineering teams with clear, detailed documentation

• Joining our Major Incident response team to resolve the most urgent and critical client problems

• Keeping the client experience at the centre of every interaction

This is a fully remote role based in Spain.
What would make me a good candidate?
We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.
Required qualifications for this role:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree, or equivalent experience in technical support or a similar client-facing role, ideally supporting software applications

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Excellent written and spoken Spanish

• Confidence engaging with clients in meetings and during critical situations

• Experience with databases, SQL and Excel, and a genuine interest in IT

• Strong attention to detail, patience and a structured way of working

• Curious and eager to learn, able to work independently and as part of a team

Nice to have:

• Experience with APIs

• Experience with payment processors such as Adyen

• Knowledge or interest in the fitness and wellbeing industry

• Worked or used a Gym Mgmt. Software before

At Xplor , we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.
Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

• Find a better way

• Do the right thing

• Say it straight

• Win together

• Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor .
As an Xplor er, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.
Some of our perks and benefits are:

• Paid Parental Leave benefit programs

• #GiveBackDays/Commitment to social impact - 3 extra days off to volunteer and give back to your local community

• Ongoing dedication to Diversity & Inclusion initiatives such as D&I Council, Global Mentorship Program

• Access to free mental health suppor

title: Online Finnish Teacher
description:
About The Job

Want to teach online Finnish courses to corporate students from all around the world, starting from September, 2026?

With our flexible scheduling, you can teach adult students at a time that suits you.

We will make sure that you have the necessary tools and materials to help you be the best teacher you can be.

• Be your own boss. You decide when you can teach

• Teach a variety of levels, during work hours

You need to meet the following requirements to start:

• Fully fluent Finnish speaker (C2 equivalent).

• Currently able to work as an independent contractor (freelance).

• Bachelor’s degree. You should have a completed bachelor’s degree.

• Minimum 120 hours Finnish language teaching qualification.

• Previous teaching experience, preferably in a corporate setting.

**Please submit your CV in English. CVs in other languages will not be considered**

About EF Teach Online

EF Teach Online is a division of EF, a global leader in language learning with more than 60 years of educational innovation. We deliver high‑quality online learning through a world‑class digital platform that reaches students around the world.

Our teams operate at the intersection of education, technology, and global operations-working across time zones to enhance our platform, improve learner engagement, and support thousands of educators and students every day.

Joining EF Teach Online means contributing to a mission‑driven, international organization focused on opening the world through education within a dynamic, innovative, and collaborative environment.

About EF Education First

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

title: Law Firm Digital Strategist
description:
Description
At Rankings.io , we help law firms grow through GEO, SEO, paid media, video, and other digital marketing services. We are looking for a Law Firm Digital Strategist to connect client objectives to clear priorities,measurable roadmaps, and coordinated work across channels. This role reports to the Chief Strategy Officer and contributes to improving our approach to client strategy.
The Account Manager owns the client relationship and ongoing communication. The Law Firm Digital Strategist owns strategic direction, the roadmap, and the analysis that informs recommendations. Channel teams own execution. This is an individual-contributor role focused on planning, analysis, and direction, without hands-on campaign management or production responsibilities. The Strategist leads strategic discussions within client meetings in partnership with the Account Manager, explains recommendations and results, and participates in occasional in-person meetings.
Responsibilities
Client Objective Translation and Roadmap Ownership

• Assess each client’s market, competitive position, desired case mix, geographic priorities, and budget to identify opportunities and constraints.

• Partner with the Account Manager and client to establish realistic growth objectives, accounting for intake performance, firm capacity, and the time required to produce results.

• Translate objectives into measurable roadmaps covering at least three months, with priorities, milestones, KPIs, and a clear rationale for the recommended approach.

• Maintain an active roadmap for every assigned client, preparing the next segment before the current one ends. Develop longer-term plans when client goals or complexity require them.

Cross-Channel Strategy and Prioritization

• Evaluate opportunities across GEO, SEO, Local SEO, paid media, video, organic social, content, link building, CRO, creative, web, and analytics.

• Establish priorities based on expected impact, dependencies, available resources, and approved client scope and budget. Identify when additional investment or approval is needed.

• Partner with channel experts to ensure execution plans support the roadmap while allowing specialists to determine the best technical approach.

• Identify blockers and sequencing issues, challenge work that does not support client objectives, and recommend a better use of resources.

Performance Analysis and Accountability

• Interpret client performance using qualified lead volume, lead quality, acquisition costs, conversion rates,signed cases where available, and relevant channel metrics.

• Diagnose underperformance, distinguish marketing issues from tracking gaps or intake challenges, and develop corrective recommendations with the appropriate teams.

• Identify when to expand successful initiatives, shift budget or effort, pursue new growth opportunities, or change the approach.

• Escalate material risks, execution blockers, data issues, and resource constraints promptly, and follow through on agreed actions.

Internal Collaboration and Client-Facing Support

• Partner closely with Account Managers to align strategic recommendations with client priorities, expectations, and commitments.

• Lead strategic discussions with clients, explaining performance findings, recommendations, trade offs, and expected outcomes.

• Keep Account Managers, channel teams, and leadership aligned on priorities and decisions, resolving strategic disagreements constructively.

Roadmap Management and Strategic Documentation

• Complete monthly strategy checkpoints to evaluate progress, performance trends, blockers, and necessary adjustments.

• Document objectives, strategic diagnosis, priorities, timelines, KPIs, risks, and next decisions, maintaining clear records of changes and assumptions.

• Adapt planning depth to each client’s needs, balancing ongoing improvements for successful accounts with deeper analysis for complex or underperforming accounts.

• Contribute to improving planning

title: Sr. Director, RCM
description:
About the Role
Daybreak Health delivers teletherapy to young people and families through schools, funded by health plans. As our Senior Director of Revenue Cycle Management, you will own the revenue cycle end to end, from enrollment through cash, for a payer mix that is narrow but operationally demanding: Medicaid and managed care organizations (MCOs), outpatient behavioral health, telehealth, and clinicians licensed across multiple states.
This is a build role, not a maintain role. You will inherit real gaps and be expected to close them with process and automation rather than headcount. You will report to our President and Co-Founder and lead the RCM team, which today includes an RCM Manager, a Lead Billing Specialist, and Billing Specialists. You will also partner closely with Finance, Clinical Operations, Product and Engineering, and Credentialing. You will present directly to executives and have clear line of sight into the cash you move.
We will not scale RCM by adding billing headcount in step with claim volume. We are looking for a leader who treats that as a design constraint and gets energized by it.
What You'll Own

•
AR and denials. Read an aging report, know where the money is stuck, and fix the root cause, not just the claim. You will build the habit of tracing denials and slow-pay patterns back to the workflow, payer rule, or system gap that created them.

•
Metrics and reporting. Run the function off numbers: net collection rate, days in AR, clean claim rate, denial rate, and cost to collect. Give leadership a view of collections they can trust, with definitions that hold up and reporting that does not depend on heroics.

•
Systems. Own the EHR, clearinghouse, and billing platform relationships and configuration. Find process gaps and build solutions, including working with Engineering when the fix lives in the product.

•
Front-end revenue integrity. Own real-time eligibility and benefits verification at intake, patient responsibility, and estimates. Most denials are created before the session happens. You will influence workflows you don't directly manage, particularly with Clinical Operations, and drive upstream behavior change.

•
Automation and AI leverage. Default to eliminating repetitive work. You will identify where automation and AI can take over manual billing, posting, follow-up, and reconciliation work, and put them into production with the right controls.

•
Cash forecasting. Be a credible partner to Finance at close, accruals, reserves, and AR allowance. Finance should never have to chase RCM for a number or wonder how it was built.

•
Compliance. Adolescent behavioral health billing carries real confidentiality risk in EOBs, statements, and minor-consent handling, on top of HIPAA and payer audit exposure. You will build the operating discipline that keeps us compliant as we scale.

What Success Looks Like

• Leadership, Finance, and the executive team trust the NCR numbers, know what is driving them, and see them improve!

• AR is understood by payer, age bucket, and root cause, and aged balances are moving in the right direction.

• Denial and clean claim rates improve because upstream workflows (eligibility, authorization, intake, documentation) are fixed at the source.

• Manual billing work keeps getting simpler or automated, and RCM capacity scales more slowly than claim volume.

• Finance gets forecasts, accruals, and reserve inputs on time, with clear assumptions and honest variance explanations.

• Clinical Operations and RCM work from shared definitions and a shared view of how clinical workflows affect revenue.

• Confidentiality, minor-consent, and audit-readiness practices are documented, trained, and followed.

What We're Looking For

• 10+ years in RCM, including 5+ years leading RCM teams.

• Experience in one or two startups. You have built from square one and stayed flexible as the business changed.

• Deep outpatient behavioral health and Medicaid/MCO billing expertise.

title: Fractional Video Director
description:
About the role
We're looking for a fractional Video Director to own our video program from strategy through production to quality.
Video has become one of our fastest-growing services. We have more than 100 videos in production across clients right now. Our current setup of agencies, freelancers and an overstretched producer isn't scaling on quality or cost. You'll fix that. That means sourcing the right partners, setting the quality bar, building the workflow, and standing behind the work with clients.
The work doesn't look like a traditional brand shoot. Our videos are built to be found and cited. That means YouTube videos, social-friendly clips, expert interviews and explainers that answer the questions buyers ask AI. Clarity and usefulness matter more than production polish.
About Foundation

Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when buyers ask AI for solutions. We do the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence where AI and buyers look: LLMs, search, Reddit and YouTube. We work with B2B brands across SaaS, HR and payroll tech, financial services, insurance and higher education.
YouTube is one of the sources AI tools regularly cite. Video done well makes our clients more likely to show up in the answer.
What you'll do

• Own video quality standards and the QA process across every video we ship, from script to final cut.

• Source, vet and manage video vendors and freelancers (editors, scriptwriters, creators). Hold them to quality, turnaround and cost.

• Build a repeatable production workflow, including in-house editing and scriptwriting where it beats outsourcing on quality or cost.

• Track cost per video and keep the program inside budget.

• Coach our creative producer and video strategists on production, feedback and client handling.

• Be the expert in the room with clients. Explain why a video is built for discovery, and push back on feedback that would hurt performance (talent choice, length, format).

• Test AI-assisted editing and scripting tools, and adopt the ones that hold up to our quality bar.

What you bring

• 10+ years in video or film production, including creative director or senior producer roles.

• Experience running video at volume across multiple vendors and freelancers.

• A working knowledge of YouTube: titles, hooks, retention, search and how videos get discovered.

• Confidence with clients. You can defend a creative call to a senior marketer and keep the relationship strong.

• A practical take on AI video tools. You know where they save time and where they fall short.

• Comfort working fractionally: async-first, decisive, and focused on the highest-leverage problems.

First 90 days

• A video QA checklist and review process used on every video before it ships.

• A vendor audit covering quality, cost per video and turnaround, with a recommendation for each vendor.

• A documented production workflow from brief to publish, including the in-house editing and scripting pilots.

• A cost-per-video baseline and target, agreed with leadership.

How we'll measure success

• Fewer revision rounds and faster turnaround from brief to publish.

• Cost per video at or under target.

• Video budget held as a percentage of revenue.

• Client satisfaction on video deliverables, and fewer escalations about video.

Compensation

• Hourly rate: $45-$65 depending on experience and location

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager for the Video Platform. You will own live streaming, historical playback, cloud backup and clip export, transcoding, third-party video ingest, and encryption of stored and exported video. Your work shows up every time someone opens a camera in Command, on a phone, through an API, or on a wall display.

What You’ll Do

• Own live view and historical playback. That includes the player, the timeline, scrubbing, time to first picture, stalls, and audio that stays with the video. Web, mobile, and API all count

• Own cloud backup and clip export. Video is recorded on the camera and copied to the cloud. You decide retention, what the backup product includes, and how reliably a clip gets out when someone asks for it

• Own reliable, quality streaming experiences, even under difficult environmental conditions. Many viewers on one camera, sites on LTE or a thin uplink, and cameras that keep recording when the cloud path is down

• Own third-party video ingested via RTSP for playback in various formats and clients

• Own customer-controlled encryption for stored and exported video, where the customer holds the keys

• Set engineering quality standards for playback, framing, and cloud backups. Proactively identify and resolve customer issues using core performance metrics for Quality of Service

• Work with sales, support, go-to-market, and design to deliver revenue-driving video products

What You Bring

• 6+ years as a product manager, currently at Lead or Group-level scope. You have owned a video area, not a single feature

• At least 3 years at a company whose product is video. Streaming, playback, recording, a VMS, real-time video, or video infrastructure all count

• More than one shipped product that an outside user watched live, played back, recorded, or exported

description:

Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

Applied Intuition is looking for a Global People Compliance & ER Partner to run our employment compliance program and support case management for employee relations across the company. This is a senior individual contributor role to design what the program should be, not just execute it.

You’ll be the People team’s subject matter expert on compliance, keeping us compliant across every country and state we operate in. Most weeks the work is a known cycle - policies, audits, training, filings, and ER casework. Some weeks a new law lands or a situation doesn’t fit any existing process, and you’ll work out the answer and turn it into something repeatable. Some of this you’ll lead outright - on other work you’ll play a key supporting role in developing, implementing, or maintaining accountability.

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

Employment Compliance Program Strategy

- Build the employment compliance framework and roadmap, spanning pre-boarding through offboarding

- Audit our practices against legal requirements in each country and state we operate in, identify where we’re exposed, and own the plan to close those gaps

- Define the recurring checks that prove we’re compliant - I-9 sampling, policy attestation, training completion, pay data validation - and the schedule for running them

- Define the metrics that make compliance health visible - risk register, audit closure, training effectiveness, ER case volume

Global Policy, Records, and Governance

- Own the employee handbook and other required employment policies and templates

- Write, maintain, and communicate updated policies; managing expectations and accountability measures of all involved.

- Build the policy governance model - version control, ownership, central location

- Use AI to improve how policy is delivered and maintained, while meeting regulatory governance and privacy requirements

- Partner with regional stakeholders on local policy, and with Legal and COEs on alignment to local law

- Run the employment records program alongside the HRIS team on data privacy and governance on employee data, files, retention schedules, access controls, etc…across jurisdictions (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, local law)

- Monitor legislative change globally and translate it into updated policy and process

- Drive compliance reporting: OFCCP, gender pay gap, time and attendance, work with in-country partners for country-specific obligations

- Own the background check program

- Own People Compliance Training through our LMS (Ethena) (i.e. sexual harassment)

Employee Relations

• At least 2 years of recent GWTG-CAD Registry abstraction experience.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.

• Comfort working in multiple EHRs, registry platforms, vendor tools, and data collection systems as assigned.

• Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.

• Contractors must have high-speed, secure internet, a PC or laptop, and at least two monitors.

• Experience using the GWTG registry platform, GWTG-CAD abstraction tools, vendor platforms, quality reporting systems, and/or related data collection tools.

title: Backend Engineer Internship
description:
Overview: Supply Chain API and Microservices Development
The Backend Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for the development, scaling, and maintenance of the core API services that power our entire integrated platform. You will build highly reliable, secure, and performant backend services within the NestJS modular monolith, focusing on critical supply chain logic, complex payment integrations, and the orchestration backbone for our AI agents.
Internship Details
Duration: 3 months
Start Date: Immediate
Location: Remote
Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.
Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will own the backend development for the most complex domain logic, ensuring scalability and transactional integrity.

• API Development & Implementation: Design, develop, and deploy highly scalable APIs for all platform components using Node.js 22 and NestJS within the TypeScript modular monolith. This includes the backends for the e-commerce checkout, internal tool APIs, and the B2B portal.

• SCM Domain Logic: Implement complex, transactional business logic within the core supply chain modules: Order Management (OMS), Warehouse Management (WMS), and Manufacturing Execution (MES). Ensure data integrity using PostgreSQL 15.

• Integrations & Payments: Implement secure, reliable integrations with third-party payment gateways and external shipping/logistics providers.

• Performance & Reliability: Implement effective caching strategies using Redis to boost API performance. Design and implement asynchronous processing and event-driven workflows to ensure system reliability and handle high-volume operations.

• Security & Monitoring: Ensure all services adhere to security standards (JWT authorization, API security). Integrate backend services with the observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki) for monitoring and tracing.

Required Technologies & Tools
Candidates must possess deep, hands-on experience with our core backend and data stack:

• Core Backend: Expert proficiency in Node.js 22, NestJS, and TypeScript (mandatory).

• Data Layer: Strong expertise in PostgreSQL 15 (schema design, query optimization) and utilizing Redis for caching.

• Architecture: Experience designing and implementing APIs (REST/GraphQL), asynchronous communication, and event-driven patterns.

• Workflow: Experience working within a Monorepo structure, contributing to CI/CD via Makefile, and utilizing Docker for local development.

AI Agent Focus
You will build the reliable, secure services required for AI agent orchestration.

• Agent Orchestration: Develop the backend services and API endpoints necessary to securely orchestrate, manage, and scale the AI agent systems.

• Data Access Services: Implement secure, high-performance services that allow AI agents (using frameworks like LangChain) to access and write necessary data to the WMS/OMS modules without compromising transactional integrity.

Success Metrics & Career Path
Performance will be measured by:

• Service Reliability: Uptime and stability of deployed services, achieving defined SLOs.

• Code Quality & Efficiency: Delivery of clean, well-tested, and performant code that scales effectively.

• Feature Velocity: Timely and efficient delivery of complex backend features, particularly within the critical OMS and WMS modules.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with Frontend, QA, and SRE teams to deliver high-quality supply chain functionality.

title: Responsable unique de sécurité - CDI
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.
La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable unique de sécurité pour rejoindre le pôle Sécurité de la Division Immobilier et Logistique de l’école.

Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

• Définir et piloter la politique de sécurité de Télécom Paris et notamment du campus de Palaiseau et en garantir sa mise en œuvre

• Être le garant du respect des règles de sécurité des biens et des personnes

• Conseiller sur les activités liées à la prévention des risques et à la sécurité des différents sites actuels

Détails des missions dans la description de poste complète.

Nous recherchons un professionnel expérimenté de la sécurité incendie, titulaire du SSIAP 3, disposant d’une solide expertise en réglementation incendie applicable aux ERP et en prévention des risques. Vous maîtrisez également les principes de la réglementation en matière de marchés publics et les modalités d’achat. Vous savez mobiliser les acteurs autour des enjeux de sécurité et accompagner les personnels avec pédagogie. Organisé(e) et fiable, vous faites preuve d’un excellent relationnel, d’un sens du dialogue et du service, ainsi que d’une capacité à fédérer et à travailler en équipe.

Une expérience en tant que sapeur-pompier professionnel ou en bureau de contrôle serait appréciée, de même qu’une connaissance des exigences liées à la protection du patrimoine scientifique et technique (PPST).

Le détention du Permis B est indispensable pour ce poste.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Vous travaillerez dans un environnement agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers, navette mutualisée en partance de la Porte d'Orléans). Vous bénéficierez de :

• 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT).

• Flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service).

• Télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible.

• Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne.

• A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé.

Découvrez notre environnement de travail, nos engagements en image et en vidéo sur notre page dédiée .

Indications de rémunération :
Fourchette indicative de rémunération (hors bonus annuel variable) : 40 000 à 52 000 euros bruts annuels, selon le profil et l’expérience, définie par notre cadre juridique. A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé.

Informations diverses :
Date limite de candidature : 28 novembre 2026
Type d'emploi : CDI

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuelle et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Hi 👋 I'm Mountain, Head of Technical Success at Pinpoint .

Pinpoint builds the hiring software that in house recruiting teams use to attract, hire and onboard the right people. We have a mature product, strong product market fit and a lot of happy customers.

Technical Success clears the technical path for everyone who touches a customer. When Sales, Customer Success or Implementation hits something complex inside the platform (a careers site change, a bulk data job through our API, an integration, a migration, an escalation nobody else can crack), it lands with us. We've just welcomed our first Senior Technical Success Engineer, and we're expanding how the team works around automation and AI rather than more hands on the queue. We want the next person to help build that, which is why we're hiring a second Senior Technical Success Engineer .

You won't know every technology on day one, but you're the kind of person who figures it out. What you should know up front

• This is a remote role, based in the UK, Spain, Portugal or Poland, with occasional in person team meetups.

• You'd report to me, inside R&D, working alongside a small team and partnering every day with Customer Success, Implementation, Sales and our engineers.

• This is not a support role. Support is reactive; this role exists to remove the reasons support gets called.

• We're an AI first team. AI writes our scripts, builds our tooling and does real work in our workflows, and we expect you to raise that bar, not just meet it.

•

• Solve the technical problems that block customer facing teams, from API and integration work to data migrations and platform configuration.

• Get under the hood of the platform to understand not just what a customer sees, but why it behaves that way and where the real fix lives.

• Turn recurring customer friction into clear signal for the product squads, not just a closed ticket.

• Be the technical partner in the room with customers, able to talk to their IT team and their talent team in the same conversation.

• Build alongside our first Senior Technical Success Engineer to set the standard for how the growing team works.

In practice, that means work like:

• Careers site changes, and fixing them when they break: custom application forms, tracking pixels, HTML and CSS tweaks, embeds that stop working after a customer changes their own site.

• Bulk data jobs through our API: mass updates, retagging thousands of records, cleanups and exports.

• Integrations set up and debugged: SSO, job board feeds, HRIS and onboarding handoffs, calendars, and customers' own API and webhook builds.

• Data migrations for customers moving off another ATS: mapping fields, cleaning messy exports and getting it all in clean.

• The escalations no one else can crack: the email that didn't send, the sync that failed silently, the config doing something nobody expected.

• Hands on technical work for customers: integrations, data, configuration and debugging, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.

• Something you've built with AI and still rely on: a workflow, agent or automation that took real work off your plate, not a certificate or a tool you tried once.

Banks of all sizes utilize our adaptable technology - on-premises, in the cloud, or as SaaS - to deliver next-generation services and AI-enhanced experiences that elevate banking for their customers. Job Responsibilities
* Identify, recruit, and onboard new partners, building strong and lasting relationships based on mutual trust and understanding.

title: Data Engineer II
description:
Job Description: Data Engineer II

About the Role

The Data Engineer II is a senior individual contributor on the Data & Reporting team responsible for translating business questions into clear reporting solutions, building data pipelines, conceptualizing and delivering trusted dashboards and analyses, and helping stakeholders move faster with better data. This role is best suited for someone with strong SQL skills, experience clarifying complex reporting needs, and the ability to turn raw backend data into actionable insights.

This role partners closely with business stakeholders and technical teammates to understand reporting needs, validate data, improve reporting outputs, and support a more scalable self-service data environment over time.

Key Responsibilities

• Partner with internal stakeholders to understand reporting needs, clarify business questions, and define the right analytical approach.

• Write and refine SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from core business systems.

• Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and recurring reporting assets that deliver clear, accurate insights to teams across the business.

• Work across backend data sources, including systems such as Salesforce and Manage, to support reporting and analysis needs.

• Validate data quality, investigate discrepancies, and troubleshoot reporting issues to improve trust in outputs.

• Translate complex findings into clear, usable summaries for both operational and leadership audiences.

• Support the broader shift toward governed, accessible data products and more scalable reporting practices.

• Contribute to documentation, repeatable reporting standards, and continuous improvement of team workflows.

Required Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role.

• Strong SQL skills with the ability to work independently across complex reporting requests.

• Experience building dashboards and analytical outputs that help stakeholders make decisions.

• Ability to clarify vague or complex reporting requests and convert them into structured deliverables.

• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and data validation instincts.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings to non-technical stakeholders.

• Comfort working across multiple systems and data sources in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools.

• Experience working with Salesforce, operational reporting, or client-facing reporting needs.

• Familiarity with data governance, standardized definitions, and self-service reporting models.

• Experience partnering with data engineers or working in an environment with evolving data platform capabilities.

What Success Looks Like

• Stakeholders receive faster, clearer, and more trusted answers to reporting questions.

• Dashboards and recurring reports are accurate, maintainable, and aligned to business definitions.

• Reporting requests are better scoped up front, reducing rework and confusion.

• Data issues and discrepancies are identified and resolved quickly.

• The team is better positioned to scale reporting through governed data sources and self-service access over time.

Job Summary
The Legal Counsel, Privacy and Data Protection will provide sophisticated, practical, and business-oriented legal advice on EU/EEA privacy and data protection matters across Nielsen’s products, services, commercial relationships, and internal operations. This role will independently manage complex privacy workstreams, support Nielsen’s European privacy program, and serve as a trusted advisor to local sales and business teams. description:
OUR STORY
TechInsights is the information Platform for the semiconductor industry.
Regarded as the most trusted source of actionable, in-depth intelligence related to semiconductor innovation and surrounding markets, TechInsights ’ content informs decision makers and professionals whose success depends on accurate knowledge of the semiconductor industry-past, present, or future.
Over 650 companies and 150,000 users access the TechInsights Platform, the world’s largest vertically integrated collection of unmatched reverse engineering, teardown, and market intelligence in the semiconductor industry. This collection includes detailed circuit analysis, imagery, semiconductor process flows, device teardowns, illustrations, costing and pricing information, forecasts, market analysis, and expert commentary. TechInsights ’ customers include the most successful technology companies who rely on TechInsights ’ analysis to make informed business, design, and product decisions faster and with greater confidence. WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Follow tariffs, trade remedies, investment screening, and supply chain security measures, and how they interact with export controls and industrial policy.
